verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a data warehouse, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes BigQuery only as a fully managed Google Cloud service with "no infrastructure to set up or manage," and nothing documents a deployable or self-hostable version of the core engine. Storing Iceberg data in customer-owned buckets and the open-source MCP Toolbox are adjacent features, not self-hosting the core product.
